lede: Green logistics uses carbon measurement and operational changes to reduce emissions across transport, warehousing and distribution. It is designed for supply chain managers, logistics planners and procurement professionals to build carbon baselines and reporting plans using ISO 14064. Participants explore route and fleet optimization, warehouse energy efficiency, and sustainable packaging and reverse logistics to identify practical ways to lower distribution impacts.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals seeking to enhance their skills and advance their careers.

Carbon Measurement and Reporting with ISO 14064
